archive-export.repair: Select a qualified docker-container builder explicitly; verify its driver before exporting the Docker archive.
archive-export.limitations: Suggestion only. Reproduce the real archive build, load, inspection and deterministic configuration before publication.

docker-config.repair: Initialize and validate the shared private Docker configuration before Buildx uses it; remove credentials before preserving builder metadata for post cleanup.
docker-config.limitations: Suggestion only. Test existing/absent directories and failure cleanup; do not erase unknown files or print credentials.

cluster-version.repair: Omit cluster-level node_version while removing the default pool; preserve min_master_version and set version on the separate managed pool.
cluster-version.limitations: Suggestion only. Use the locked provider and review a real saved plan; do not upgrade providers or weaken controls.
